title: Chemical Composition in the IRAS 16562-3959 High-mass Star-forming Region
question: What is the chemical composition of the three cores in the IRAS 16562-3959 G345.5+1.47 MYSO region, how is H2CO formed, and what causes the 33SO ring around the HC HII region?

data.sensitivity: 1sigma noise 1.1-2.1 mJy/beam per cube; continuum rms 1.6 mJy/beam

evidence.quote: The distance and bolometric luminosity ($L_{\rm {bol}}$) are 2.4 kpc and 154400 $L_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ (cite: 2013ApJS..208...11L), respectively.

what.value: Dust opacity law kappa=0.1(nu/THz)^beta with beta=1.6

evidence.loc: 3.1 Continuum Image and the H2 Column Density of Identified Cores

what.value: Chemical model results for H2CO (Nautilus, 3-phase slow warm-up)

evidence.quote: We investigate main formation pathways of H$_{2}$CO using the results of (cite: 2019ApJ...881...57T) with the Nautilus (cite: 2016MNRAS.459.3756R).

what.value: Rest frequencies and Eu from CDMS and JPL

evidence.quote: Rest frequency and excitation energy are taken from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (cite: 2005JMoSt.742..215M).

recipe.method: tclean with natural weighting; imcontsub for continuum
2D Gaussian fits to moment zero maps of H30alpha (Core A) and CH3OH (Cores B, C)

recipe.goal: Derive H2 column density from dust continuum
recipe.method: Kauffmann et al. 2008 formula with free-free subtracted for Core A

recipe.goal: CH3CN rotational diagram for Tex and N
recipe.method: Gaussian fits to K=0-7 lines of J=12-11, rotational diagram, optically thin LTE

recipe.goal: Derive column densities of other species
recipe.method: CASSIS LTE model with MCMC and chi2 minimization, two Tex cases (50-200 K; ranges around CH3CN Tex)
key_parameters: source size 0.3" Core A, 0.5" Cores B and C; filling factor 1; FWHM free between 1 and 10 km/s

recipe.goal: Fractional abundances and comparison with models
recipe.method: X = N(mol)/N(H2) at Cores B and C; compared with Nautilus model results

answer_key.quantity: CH3CN N and Tex, Core A
CH3CN N and Tex, Core B
CH3CN N and Tex, Core C
H30alpha peak and FWHM at Core A

evidence.quote: The peak intensity and full width half maximum (FWHM) were derived to be $46.7 \pm 0.3$ K ($1\sigma$) and $49.5 \pm 0.3$ km s$^{-1}$, respectively.

answer_key.quantity: Free-free contribution to continuum at Core A

evidence.quote: Therefore, the expected free-free contribution to the continuum is $46.7~{\rm K}/2.55 = 18.3$ K.

not_stated_but_needed: tclean cell size, image size, niter, threshold, masks
flux calibrator and flux scale uncertainty
velocity range used for moment zero maps
CASSIS MCMC settings (iterations, priors, chain length)
Core A free-free-subtracted continuum flux value used in N(H2)
score_reason: Public data and named tools, but imaging parameters and fitting configuration are not given.
rediscovery_reason: Public data; numeric Tex/N results for CH3CN and N(H2) can be rederived, though imaging details are missing.
